title: What Do Near Death Experiences PROVE? It’s Not What You Thought!

top_liked.text: I almost drowned in the ocean once. I never saw any angels or Jesus, just blue electrical lights going off in my head. I swear, a lot of people are making up these stories for clout.

top_liked.text: I almost died in 2012 after getting hit by a truck. I experienced non existence. Comparable to how it was before we were all born. I forgot my entire life. The ICU doctors knew what they were doing so I faded back into consciousness and slowly started recalling everything after…

top_liked.text: People 'came back' with wild tales of hell and heaven and I'm like 'where's that in the bible?'. They sounded more inspired by entertainment culture than anything else. And that told me even if genuine, it was their own brains firing off their own pre-existing mental conditions.…

top_liked.text: DMT. It gets released from your brain close to death.  Or, you can smoke it and experience death and rebirth and entities that may look like your aunt Bertha if her face was made of infinite lines and colors.

top_liked.text: I was a very devoted Christian when I had a near death experience in hospital. I didn’t see angels, god, or anything like that. I just felt like I was outside of my body, floating toward the ceiling, and then down the hallway. It was pure peace.
